title: Marshall A, Altman DG, Royston P, Holder RL. Comparison of techniques for handling missing covariate data within prognostic modelling studies: a simulation study. BMC Medical Research Methodology 10:7 (2010)
about: Our value for every published table cell, Figure 1 bar, reference line and claim that the reproduction compares, and for Figures 2 to 8 the number of plotted points (read from the article's vector figures) within tolerance; the reproduce workflow checks every point through comparison.json. CI reruns the pipeline (replicate 1 of the MAR and MNAR studies from scratch; the rest from the committed per-replicate results in output/sim) and checks each value with tools/check_results.py.
